newsitem.title: UK: Green lira to revalue, two others to devalue - HGCA.
newsitem.headline: Green lira to revalue, two others to devalue - HGCA.

text.p: The green Italian lira will revalue to 1,973.93 per Ecu from 2,030.40 in the European Union's agrimonetary system on Tuesday following a 10-day assessment, the UK's Home-Grown Cereals Authority (HGCA) said on Monday.
It said the green mark would devalue to 1.91692 per Ecu from 1.91639 and that of the guilder to 2.14989 per Ecu from 2.14934.
The devaluations followed the position of the Irish punt in the agrimonetary grid which the HGCA reckoned would move to the second of possibly five 10-day confirmation periods towards a revaluation.
During the revaluation process any green currency hovering above the market rate is devalued.
The Italian lira meanwhile had only one confirmation period because previous devaluations have offset the impact of revaluation on farmers' income.
EU green rates are used in converting farm subsidies into national currencies.
